review_evidence: README identifies Partax as a Lean syntax/parser manipulation library whose commands compile parser categories and definitions into runnable parsers.

The unit's primary Lean set includes Partax implementation modules plus test/example files that execute the library's custom compilation commands; the tests therefore carry concrete syntax/parser usage rather than documentation-only scaffolding.
The Lean lakefile is build DSL and no content-level invariant justifies deleting formal-language build or test material under FILTER-008/FILTER-011; no safe primary exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete Partax Lean corpus, including executable parser examples and tests; no lossless hard exclusion was established.
